meta.source: research round 2026-09-10 — CN round 42: the two-layer sweep finished on its last five yearbooks; seven nodes minted off publisher pages found for the multi-citation list; NBS's fourth listing (部门统计调查制度) found
meta.note: Round 42, Thomas's brief: 'start 1 and 2' — finish HANDOFF 083 §3 item 1 (the two-layer sweep on Nanjing, Jilin, Jiangsu, Hubei, Yunnan) and mint the multi-citation nodeless instruments rather than grind one node at a time. RESULT: 7 nodes, 29 edges, all A-graded by the grader unless the grade field says otherwise. THE SWEEP paid 8 edges on three yearbooks (Nanjing's and Jiangsu's per-chapter 主要统计指标解释 pages, Hubei's spreadsheet table notes) and settled Jilin (three layers, nothing) and Yunnan (table layer, nothing new). THE HUNT paid better: seven publisher pages in one round, four of them because NBS turns out to host the full text of every departmental survey system it approves at /fw/bmdcxmsp/bmzd/ (512 entries) — a fourth NBS listing beside 统计制度, 统计标准 and 法规 — and one because NBS's 统计出版物 listing carries 中国统计摘要 after three rounds of 'no NBS page'. Each minted node arrived with 3-6 citing documents already read, so the edges per node are 1 (two SAMR/MOFCOM instruments only Jiangsu names), 3 (小企业会计准则, 文化文物旅游, 对外承包工程管理条例), 4 (运输货物分类和代码) and 6 (中国统计摘要). ONE JUDGEMENT CALL TO CHECK, flagged on the node and on both edges: Jiangsu and Nanjing write 《全国文物文化和旅游统计调查制度》 for the publisher's 《全国文化文物和旅游统计调查制度》; the transposed form is carried as a title alias on the `hs` 和/及 precedent and two edges rest on it. ONE GRADER CHANGE: spreadsheets inside a zip are now read (third pass in extractZipDocs), which is what lets Hubei's table notes grade. Device shell down for the whole session, as in round 41: stage → sandbox → device_commit_files. Working files (fetched pages, the extracted zips, the 512-row departmental listing) under the sandbox's /home/claude/cn.

reports.title: 小企业会计准则 (Accounting Standards for Small Enterprises)
reports.publisher: 财政部 (Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The Ministry of Finance's simplified accounting standard for small enterprises, issued as 财会〔2011〕17号 on 2011-10-18 and in force from 2013-01-01, replacing the 2004 小企业会计制度. It sits beside the full 企业会计准则 as the second of the two accounting bases a Chinese enterprise may keep its books under, and that is exactly how statistical yearbooks name it: their 主要统计指标解释 for industrial, real-estate and service-enterprise financial indicators (资产总计, 负债合计, 管理费用, 研发费用, 营业利润, 固定资产) tell the reader which line of the enterprise's own 利润表 or 资产负债表 to take depending on whether the enterprise executes 企业会计准则 or 《小企业会计准则》. The cited page is the Ministry's own 会计司 policy-release page carrying the issuing notice in full. Minted round 42 off three independent yearbook citations (Xi'an, Suzhou, Guangdong) after round 40 opened the lead.
reports.cadence_note: A standing standard, issued once in 2011 and effective 2013; not reissued on a cycle.

reports.title: 运输货物分类和代码 (JT/T 19-2001, Classification and Codes of Transport Cargo)
reports.publisher: 交通运输部 (Ministry of Transport of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The transport-industry standard (交通行业标准, recommended) that classifies and codes goods carried by road, water, rail and air, JT/T 19-2001, issued 2001-04-10 and effective 2001-08-01, replacing JT 0019-1988; drafted by 交通部科学研究院 and 交通部综合规划司, last reviewed 2022-12-06 with the conclusion 修订. Statistical yearbooks name it in the definition of 港口货物吞吐量: cargo throughput is classified by goods category 根据现行的交通行业《运输货物分类和代码》标准. The cited page is the standard's own entry on the Ministry's 交通运输标准化信息平台 (jtst.mot.gov.cn), which records number, status, dates, drafters and the superseded standard. Minted round 42 off four independent yearbook citations (national zb16, Shanghai C1505, Hunan zb15, Nanjing chapter 8) after round 38 opened the lead.
reports.cadence_note: A standing industry standard, one edition (2001) in force; under review for revision since 2022.

reports.title: 全国文化文物和旅游统计调查制度 (National Statistical Survey System for Culture, Cultural Heritage and Tourism)
title_aliases: 全国文化文物和旅游统计调查制度
全国文物文化和旅游统计调查制度
reports.publisher: 文化和旅游部 (Ministry of Culture and Tourism of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The Ministry of Culture and Tourism's departmental statistical survey system (部门统计调查制度), formulated by the Ministry under the Statistics Law and approved by NBS: a full-coverage annual reporting survey of culture and tourism enterprises and institutions under the Ministry's administration, plus sample surveys of domestic, Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan and inbound visitors, whose results are published in 中国文化和旅游统计年鉴 and 旅游抽样调查资料. Provincial and city yearbooks name it as the instrument under which their domestic-tourism series are compiled and revised (Yunnan tables 1-4-1 and 12-1; Jiangsu table 14-12; Nanjing table 11-6). The cited page is the instrument's own entry on NBS's 部门统计调查制度 listing (/fw/bmdcxmsp/bmzd/), the approving authority's register of every departmental system, which opens 文化和旅游部制定的《全国文化文物和旅游统计调查制度》 and carries its purpose, scope, content, method and organisation in full; the 2024-04-23 entry is the newest of the two on the listing. NODE CAVEAT: the issuing body is the Ministry and the cited page is on the approving body's host (rule 19: authorship, not host); the Ministry's own site carries only the 2013 predecessor 《全国文化文物统计报表制度》 — move the URL if an MCT page for the current title is located. TITLE VARIANT: Jiangsu and Nanjing both write 《全国文物文化和旅游统计调查制度》, the two middle nouns transposed; there is no instrument of that name and the alias is carried on the 2026-09-08 precedent of `hs` (商品名称和/及编码协调制度), Thomas ruled 2026-09-10 (round 43): KEEP the alias; both edges stand. Minted round 42.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued periodically as a departmental survey system approved by NBS; the listing carries a 2021-07-12 and a 2024-04-23 edition.

reports.title: 市场监管统计调查制度 (Market Regulation Statistical Survey System)
title_aliases: 市场监管统计调查制度
reports.publisher: 国家市场监督管理总局 (State Administration for Market Regulation)
reports.description: The State Administration for Market Regulation's departmental statistical survey system (部门统计调查制度) approved by NBS, covering business-entity registration, administrative licensing, enforcement, consumer protection, quality infrastructure and staffing across all market-regulation authorities nationally; the 2024-02-05 edition succeeds the 2023 市场监督管理统计调查制度. A provincial yearbook names it when it explains a change of scope in its own tables: Jiangsu's 2025 yearbook records that from 2024, 根据《市场监管统计调查制度》, foreign-invested enterprises' investment amounts and registered capital (table 8-1) and commodity trading markets (table 14-1) are no longer collected. The cited page is the instrument's own entry on NBS's 部门统计调查制度 listing, the approving authority's register, carrying purpose, objects, scope, content and method in full. NODE CAVEAT: issuing body SAMR, page on the approving body's host (rule 19); move the URL if a samr.gov.cn page for the instrument is located. Minted round 42.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued as a departmental survey system approved by NBS; the listing carries a 2023 and a 2024 edition.

reports.title: 外商投资统计调查制度 (Foreign Investment Statistical Survey System)
title_aliases: 外商投资统计调查制度
reports.publisher: 商务部 (Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The Ministry of Commerce's departmental statistical survey system (部门统计调查制度) approved by NBS for foreign investment statistics, formulated under the Statistics Law and the Foreign Investment Law, covering foreign-invested enterprises, foreign financial branches and oil-and-gas projects in China. It is the instrument that fixes which figures a provincial statistical yearbook may print for utilised foreign capital: Jiangsu's 2025 yearbook cites its 2022 edition's rule that provincial commerce departments supplying foreign-investment data to statistics departments for yearbooks must use the figures fed back by the Ministry. The cited page is the newest (2025-07-02) edition's entry on NBS's 部门统计调查制度 listing, the approving authority's register, with purpose, objects, scope, content and method in full; the listing also carries a 2023-02-15 entry. One node for the reissued instrument, as with NBS's own annually reissued 统计报表制度 nodes; a dated citation reaches it. NODE CAVEAT: issuing body MOFCOM, page on the approving body's host (rule 19); move the URL if a mofcom.gov.cn page for the instrument is located. Minted round 42.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued periodically as a departmental survey system approved by NBS; editions of 2022 (cited by Jiangsu), 2023 and 2025 are known.

reports.title: 对外承包工程管理条例 (Regulations on the Administration of Foreign Contracted Projects)
title_aliases: 对外承包工程管理条例
reports.publisher: 国务院 (State Council of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The State Council regulation governing Chinese enterprises' contracting of construction projects abroad, promulgated as 国务院令第527号 on 2008-07-21 (in force 2008-09-01) and amended by the 2017-03-01 国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定. Its article 2 defines 对外承包工程 as 中国的企业或者其他单位承包境外建设工程项目的活动, and that definition is what the national, Hubei and Nanjing statistical yearbooks reproduce verbatim, prefaced 根据《对外承包工程管理条例》, as the scope of their 对外承包工程 series — a definitional use of a legal instrument, which is a legal_basis edge under the 2026-09-10 ruling (a document that defines a series' scope under a law names the law as its basis). The cited page is the amended text in the State Council Gazette (国务院公报 增刊2017·1) on gov.cn; the original 2008 promulgation is at https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2008/content_1065453.htm. One node for the regulation in its 2017-amended state, on the same reasoning as 三次产业划分规定（2012）: the amendment is a revising decision, not a retitled edition. Minted round 42 after round 38 opened the lead.
reports.cadence_note: A standing State Council regulation, promulgated 2008 and amended 2017; not reissued on a cycle.

reports.title: China Statistical Abstract (中国统计摘要)
reports.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)
reports.description: NBS's annual pocket compendium (国家统计局 编, 中国统计出版社 出版), the concise companion to the China Statistical Yearbook: a comprehensive digest of the previous year's main economic and social indicators with headline historical series since 1978, released each May — some four months before the Yearbook — across general, population, national accounts, employment and wages, prices, living standards, fiscal, resources and energy, investment, trade, agriculture, industry, construction, retail and tourism, transport, finance, science and education, health, culture, and the Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan and international appendices. Because it is the earliest official source of national and all-province comparison figures, provincial and city yearbooks reprint their 'national share' and 'all provinces' appendices from it and name it by title with the edition year (Shandong ch23, Jiangsu ch21, Hubei appendix, Yunnan table 1-6, Nanjing table 1-15, Guangdong appendix). The cited page is the 2022 edition's entry on NBS's own 统计出版物 listing (/zs/tjwh/tjkw/tjzl/), which records compiler, publisher, ISBN, date and contents; the listing's newest Abstract entry is 2022, so the 2024 and 2025 editions the yearbooks cite have no NBS page of their own yet — one node for the annual publication, as with cn-statistical-yearbook, and a dated citation reaches it. Minted round 42 after being named by six yearbooks across rounds 29-42.
reports.cadence_note: Annual, published each May for the preceding year.

_dropped.note: scripts/grade-evidence.ts extractZipDocs gained a THIRD pass (2026-09-10): .xlsx files inside a zip are read with the existing extractXlsx reader, legacy .xls are converted with `soffice --headless --convert-to xlsx` in ONE batched call per source directory (a process start is ~4 s; Hubei's zip holds 340 of them) into a per-directory subfolder (so two chapters' identically named 续表 files cannot collide) and read the same way. It runs after the markup pass and after the docx/pdf pass, spends only the budget those leave, and so can only ADD text to any already-committed zip record — the same §7b argument round 37 made for the second pass. WHY: the table notes of a yearbook shipped as a zip of spreadsheets were unreadable to the grader while being a direct read under Thomas's 2026-09-08 ruling; Yunnan's table-note edge graded A in round 37 only because Yunnan's zip also ships the whole book as a PDF, and Hubei's does not. tsc clean, selftest 76/76 unchanged, no test added (the xlsx reader is the tested one). A missing soffice, or a file it refuses, skips that file and nothing else.
